premises.text: Fans face significant challenges navigating their game day experience.
premises.evidence_span: this wasn't just our problem. This is what any fan experiences at any game, anywhere in the world

premises.text: Crowd-sourced information can help fans find important locations and people during events.
premises.evidence_span: a social mapping app that leverages crowd-sourced information to help fans find what matters most, tailgates, parking, food, beer, or even your friends in a crowd of people

premises.text: The app can provide turn-by-turn directions to parking spots.
premises.evidence_span: Whitney fires up the Paranoid Fan app to get turn-by-turn directions from her house to her parking spot

premises.text: The app allows users to locate friends easily in crowded environments.
premises.evidence_span: Whitney can use the Meet Me feature to see exactly where her friends are

premises.text: The app enhances fan engagement through features like live geofence chat streams.
premises.evidence_span: entered into a live geofence chat stream that allows fans within two miles of the 50-yard line to share photos, video, information, or a collective high-five

premises.text: The app saves users time during their game day experience.
premises.evidence_span: we estimate that we've saved Whitney more than an hour of her time

premises.text: The app is designed to be easy for users to pin locations on the map.
premises.evidence_span: Pinning on the Paranoid fan map is incredibly easy for our users

premises.text: The app is available for download and can be used at major sporting events.
premises.evidence_span: Paranoid fan is now available on the app store

value.text: Fans gain a more enjoyable and efficient game day experience.
value.evidence_span: We're giving fans back what's most valuable to them, their time

notes: Traction details and specific partnerships excluded as they do not constitute premises.
